label: SCAN — unreviewed, 2026-09-30

scope.included: QuickBooks Online US plans as the pricing page names them (Free, Simple Start, Essentials, Plus, Advanced) plus the add-ons sold with them: Payroll (Workforce bundles), QuickBooks Payments, QuickBooks Time, and the QBO mobile and desktop apps.
excluded: Intuit Enterprise Suite: separate mid-market product, mentioned only where QBO pages pair it with Advanced
Intuit Accountant Suite: firm product; QBO Accountant noted only as accountant access
Intuit Expert / Live Bookkeeping and Full Service Bookkeeping: human services, not software
Non-US QuickBooks editions (CA, UK, AU, global)

clientApps.name: Intuit QuickBooks for Business (listed as QuickBooks Online Accounting in some regions)
Workforce app (QuickBooks Time / Payroll employee app)

api.style: REST (JSON) plus webhooks, Change Data Capture and batch operations
api.notes: QuickBooks Online Accounting API on developer.intuit.com. Webhooks notify of changes to subscribed entities; CDC returns entities changed since a date-time; a batch request holds up to 30 payloads. Auth (OAuth 2.0) and the throttling limits are documented but the pages could not be read, so they are not confirmed here.

capabilities.description: Double-entry books of record for the company: income, expenses and accounts that feed every report; the pricing page lists income and expense tracking on every plan including Free.

capabilities.vendorName: Connect bank account, bank rules, Book reconciliation
capabilities.description: Bank and card connections pull transactions into a For review list; up to 2,000 bank rules auto-categorise them, and accounts are reconciled against statements. Pricing lists an AI-assisted book reconciliation on Plus.
capabilities.tierNote: Free connects 1 bank; AI reconciliation and auto-verification listed from Plus

capabilities.description: Create and send invoices from templates, and estimates that customers can sign on mobile and that convert into invoices; bulk invoice creation (AI) from Essentials and batch invoices on Advanced.
capabilities.tierNote: Free is limited to 2 invoices a month (unlimited with Payments)

capabilities.description: Tracks invoice status and payments received; Payments AI analyses customer payment behaviour, drafts reminders and gives cash-flow visibility to raise collection rates.
capabilities.tierNote: Payments AI is listed from Essentials

capabilities.description: Record vendor bills and pay them by ACH from QuickBooks; approval workflows for bills on Advanced; Bill Pay Elite is a separate add-on tier.
capabilities.tierNote: approval workflows on Advanced; Bill Pay Elite add-on

capabilities.description: Categorise expenses (AI categorisation from Simple Start) and snap receipts on mobile; QuickBooks reads merchant, date and amount and matches them to bank transactions. An Expense Submitter role lets staff submit expenses.
capabilities.tierNote: expense categorisation listed from Simple Start

capabilities.description: Automatic GPS trip tracking in the mobile app with swipe classification of business vs personal trips, to claim vehicle deductions; QuickBooks Time Elite also tracks employee mileage.

Accept cards, ACH, Apple Pay, PayPal/Venmo and Affirm on invoices and payment links, and in person via tap to pay on iPhone (card reader on Android); payments post automatically to QuickBooks Online, with instant deposit.

capabilities.description: Recurring invoices and other transactions that are recorded automatically, as reminders or as unscheduled templates; QuickBooks Payments can charge customers on a schedule.
Payroll add-on bundled with a QBO plan: auto payroll, tax filing, next- or same-day direct deposit, benefits and workers' comp access; Payroll AI can collect employee info and run payroll.
capabilities.tierNote: add-on; bundles named Workforce Payroll + Simple Start/Essentials and Workforce Premium + Plus

capabilities.description: HR tools included in the payroll bundles (basic on Workforce Payroll, advanced on Workforce Premium) and an HR Manager user role.
capabilities.tierNote: payroll add-on only

capabilities.description: Employee time tracking on a mobile Workforce app or kiosk, shift and job scheduling, time off, and timesheets flowing to invoices and payroll; Time Elite adds project tracking and budget vs actual hours. Requires a QuickBooks Online account.
capabilities.tierNote: separate add-on (Time Premium, Time Elite) or included in Workforce Premium + Plus; pricing lists 'employee time to invoices' from Essentials

capabilities.description: Calculates sales tax from state rules, tracks liabilities and records or e-files returns in some states; Sales Tax AI categorises items and checks returns for discrepancies before filing.

capabilities.description: Personalised dashboards with custom KPIs and metrics; unlimited custom KPIs on Advanced.
Budget planning from Plus, with a chat to model scenarios and save them as budgets (beta); cash flow projections in the mobile app; Finance AI summarises performance for planning on Advanced.
Track profitability per project from Plus; Advanced adds Project Management AI that auto-creates projects and allocates costs, advanced project financials and construction job costing.

Forms that collect leads into QuickBooks.
Choose from multiple invoice templates or create your own.

extraction.note: The UI Export data tool gives reports and lists as Excel in one .zip, with separate exports for attachments, estimates, POs, recurring templates and more, but the audit log cannot be exported to Excel and has no API. Backups exist only on Advanced, and restoring one leaves out budgets and inventory history. The Accounting API has query, Attachable and Change Data Capture (changedSince, up to 30 days back, deletes flagged), plus webhooks. So delta sync is possible, but not all data can be pulled by API.

exportOptions.name: Export data (Settings > Tools > Export data)
exportOptions.description: Exports reports and lists as Excel files in one .zip file, covering posting transactions such as invoices, receipts and bills. You pick a date range and switch reports and lists on or off.
exportOptions.limits: No row or size limits stated on the page

exportOptions.name: Per-report / per-list Export to Excel
exportOptions.description: Separate exports for non-posting items: estimates, purchase orders, customer statements (print then download as PDF), recurring templates (Recurring Template List report), chart of accounts, and products and services.

exportOptions.name: Attachments batch export
exportOptions.description: Settings > Lists > Attachments: select attachments, then Batch actions > Export. The files come out in a zip file.

exportOptions.name: Export after cancellation (read-only access)
exportOptions.description: After cancelling, you have read-only access and can export data to Excel or to a desktop version of QuickBooks.
exportOptions.limits: Paid subscriptions: read-only access and export for one year after cancelling. Cancelled or expired trials: 90 days. A declined card leaves 14 days to update billing before the account is suspended.

exportOptions.name: Online Backup and Restore (Personal cloud archive export)
exportOptions.description: Automatic backups once turned on, a manual Full backup, and point-in-time restore that overwrites the whole company. Backups can be exported to a linked Google Drive as a Personal cloud archive in .cab format, and a cloud archive cannot be restored for now.
exportOptions.limits: Keeps snapshots from the last year and restores to within one previous calendar year. Restore leaves out budgets (save them as CSV), inventory history and adjustments, and tax rates that use expense accounts. A Google Drive export may take 10 minutes or more.
exportOptions.lowestTier: QuickBooks Online Advanced (page is tagged Advanced and Intuit Enterprise Suite)

apis.name: Accounting API query
apis.description: SQL-like query of Accounting API entities, paged (a client library pages at 1000 per page by default). Deleted entities are not returned by a standard query. Filtering on MetaData.LastUpdatedTime was not confirmed from a readable page.

apis.name: Change Data Capture (CDC)
apis.description: GET /v3/company/<realmID>/cdc?entities=<entityList>&changedSince=<dateTime> returns the listed entities changed since a date-time. Lookback is up to 30 days, and at most 1000 objects come back per response, so poll shorter windows if you hit it. Deleted entities come back with status "Deleted".

apis.name: Webhooks
apis.description: Notifies the app when subscribed entities change, per the earlier product scan. The event payload and retry details could not be read.

apis.name: Batch
apis.description: Several operations or queries in one request. The maximum is 30 payloads per the Intuit search snippet and product scan, while the quickbooks-ruby README says 25. The official page could not be read to settle it.

apis.name: Attachable / Upload
apis.description: Attachable entities hold attachment metadata and a temporary download URI (temp_download_uri) for the file. Invoice, SalesReceipt and Payment PDFs can be downloaded. This comes from a third-party client library's docs, not an official page.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow: the authorize URL is appcenter.intuit.com/connect/oauth2, tokens come from oauth.platform.intuit.com/oauth2/v1/tokens/bearer, the scope is com.intuit.quickbooks.accounting, and a realmId identifies the company. Access tokens last 1 hour. The client library falls back to 100 days for refresh-token expiry when x_refresh_token_expires_in is not returned. All of this is from a third-party client README. The official OAuth page and the production-key/app-assessment requirements could not be read.

rateLimits.summary: Not confirmed from a vendor page. An Intuit developer forum question title cites '500 QBO API requests per minute and the maximum of 10 concurrent requests'. A search snippet says some concurrent and batch limits were not enforced until they were corrected on August 10th, 2024. CDC caps a response at 1000 objects. The official throttling articles are JS-rendered and returned no text.

hardToExtract.detail: The audit log keeps events for two years, is admin-only, and shows 150 records at a time in the UI. Intuit forum answers (search snippets) say the audit trail is not exposed to the API, is only reachable in the UI, and cannot be exported to Excel (PDF save or copy-paste only). The official help article describes no export.

Change Data Capture only reaches back 30 days, and a standard query does not return deleted entities. Deletions older than 30 days cannot be recovered by API, so a delta sync has to run at least that often.

Restoring a backup leaves out budgets (they must be saved as CSV), inventory history and inventory adjustments. The Personal cloud archive (.cab) cannot be restored for now, and a restore replaces the whole company rather than un-deleting items.
In the UI, attachments are exported separately from the Export data zip, through the Attachments list's batch action. By API, each file needs its own Attachable download URI (from third-party docs).

migrationTools.name: Export to QuickBooks Desktop
migrationTools.description: After cancelling, data can be exported to a desktop version of QuickBooks as well as to Excel.

migrationTools.name: Third-party backup apps (app center)
migrationTools.description: The export help page points to third-party backup apps in the QuickBooks app center, without naming any.
